entries.en: HMPH, WHO ARE YOU!? WHAT ARE[n]TINY BRATS LIKE YOU DOING HERE?
Don't be so rude.
We're the Phantom Thieves.
Are we in the way?
[clr 2]AHAHAHAHA[clr 27]! RUDE? HOW DARE[n]YOU SPEAK THAT WAY TO ME!
NOW LISTEN HERE! I AM A GREATLY[n]IMPORTANT FIGURE HERE AT THIS[n][clr 2]BEST OF THE BEST[clr 27] CORPORATION!
THE ONLY RUDENESS HERE IS YOUR[n]INTRUSION! HOW DID YOU GET IN!?
THE PHANTOM THIEVES!? SO YOU[n]ADMIT TO INTRUDING IN THIS PLACE!
HOW BRAZEN OF YOU! IT IS TIME[n]I TEACH YOU ALL A LESSON!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, I was just feeling in the mood for a[n]spot of excitement. Let us do this, Joker!
OF COURSE! WHERE DO YOU THINK[n]YOU ARE!?
THIS CORPORATION IS THE [clr 2]BEST OF THE[clr 27][n][clr 2]BEST[clr 27]: OKUMURA FOODS! YOU SHOULD[n]NOT BE HERE!
MORE IMPORTANTLY, WHO ARE ALL[n]OF YOU!? HOW DID YOU GET IN!?
We snuck in.
Through the front door.
That's a secret.
YOU WHAT!? SO YOU ARE NO[n]DIFFERENT THAN BURGLARS!
AH, I SEE! YOU MUST BE SPIES FROM A[n]RIVAL COMPANY! IN THAT CASE, I WILL[n]CAPTURE YOU MYSELF!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, I was just feeling in the mood for a[n]spot of excitement. Let us do this, Joker!
THROUGH THE FRONT DOOR? SO[n]YOU MEAN TO SAY YOU'RE NOT[n]ANYBODY SUSPICIOUS?
YOUR LOOKS WORRY ME... BUT[n]IT WOULD BE A PROBLEM IF I [n]MISTAKENLY REPORTED YOU...
A SECRET!? WHAT KIND OF FOOL[n]DO YOU TAKE ME FOR!?
ALTHOUGH I DID HEAR ABOUT AN[n]UPCOMING SECRET INSPECTION...[n]WHAT IF YOU'RE THE INSPECTORS?
HMMM, YOU LOOK A LITTLE TOO[n]SUSPICIOUS TO BE INSPECTORS...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It is time we make our decision, Joker.[n]What do you want to do?
Let's fight him.
We should leave.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Right, there's no need for any more[n]discussion. Take him down!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So you don't want to fight right now?[n]Then let's retreat!
HOLD ON A MOMENT! JUST WHAT[n]IS GOING ON HERE!? HEY!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Serves you right, bastard! That takes[n]care of that!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This guy's got nothing on him though.[n]1000% waste of time.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I-It seems their physical size doesn't[n]necessarily correlate to their rank...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The chief director must be somewhere[n]else... Let's try looking in another room.
